subject.title: WhatsApp: support pre-built link previews in sendMessage + batch send RPC method

question: Should OpenClaw accept only the narrow WhatsApp pre-built linkPreview pass-through now, or also include automatic preview fetching and a public batch send RPC in this issue?
rationale: The pass-through is a bounded dependency-supported plugin change, while automatic fetching changes URL-fetch security posture and send.batch changes the stable Gateway protocol surface.

options.title: Stage the work
options.body: Implement the typed pre-built linkPreview pass-through first and require separate maintainer-approved designs for automatic fetching and send.batch.

options.title: Approve full combined feature
options.body: Treat linkPreview pass-through, opt-in automatic fetching, and send.batch as one larger feature after security and Gateway protocol review.

options.title: Defer to plugin/API design
options.body: Keep this open only as design input until maintainers decide whether the batch and preview controls belong in core Gateway APIs or plugin-owned actions.

recommendation.title: Stage the work
recommendation.body: Implement the typed pre-built linkPreview pass-through first and require separate maintainer-approved designs for automatic fetching and send.batch.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current routing candidate from blame on the affected code and prior consolidation of the narrower tracker into this issue.
